This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 04-05-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Hollandse Precisie BV, with its registered office at Keizersgracht 12, Rotterdam ("Party A"), and Van Dijk Handel
BV, with its registered office at Industrieweg 88, Rotterdam ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signatures

Party A    Hollandse Precisie BV / Emma Bakker
Party B    Van Dijk Handel BV / Jan de Vries
